name: ICU-TSB
description: Patient stratification identifying clinically meaningful subgroups is essential for advancing personalized medicine through improved diagnostics and treatment strategies. Electronic health records (EHRs), particularly those from intensive care units (ICUs), contain rich temporal clinical data that can be leveraged for this purpose. In this work, we introduce ICU-TSB (Temporal Stratification Benchmark), the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating patient stratification based on temporal patient representation learning using three publicly available ICU EHR datasets. A key contribution of our benchmark is a novel hierarchical evaluation framework utilizing disease taxonomies to measure the alignment of discovered clusters with clinically validated disease groupings. reputation: A new, specialized benchmark for temporal patient stratification that is still emerging in the medical informatics community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on ICU EHR time-series data; likely small-to-moderate dataset size and domain-specific evaluation, so results are not directly comparable to general ML benchmarks.
